_comment: Candidate USB IDs for EVOS FL Auto (AMAFD1000) subsystems, derived from STATIC analysis of vendor software packages (see docs/evidence/vendor_software_analysis.md). These describe what the vendor software EXPECTS, not what has been observed on our unit, so a match is a candidate role mapping, never 'verified'. Confidence follows the ADR-0003 bands.

sources.usb_ids: linux-usb.org usb.ids database (vendor 0DAD = Westover Scientific; 1E10 = Point Grey Research; 1409 = IDS Imaging)

candidates.device: AMG 'CN' (ChuckNorris) control board, PIC24F USB HID: incubator temperature/CO2/O2/humidity/gas control
candidates.label: strongly_supported
basis: fl1_v1.6 CNControlBoard64.dll references Vid_0dad&Pid_0058 and has PID loops for water/glass/chamber/hose temperature and CO2/O2/gas-flow controllers
fl2_v2.0.2094 loads the same COM component (8/8 GUIDs, 270/270 parameter names shared) from its Incubator plug-in
alternatives: a different AMG board in application mode sharing this PID
AMC1000 hardware revision with a different board

candidates.device: EVOS Gen III LED board (also stores stage HW_DATA: axis offsets, registration, mm/rev)
candidates.label: strongly_supported
basis: fl1_v1.6 EvosGenIII_LEDBoard64.dll references Vid_0dad&Pid_0051 and exposes LED/epi channel and HW_DATA methods
alternatives: LED board in a different firmware mode

candidates.device: AMG board ID listed by the LED-board bootloader DLL (bootloader-mode or sibling board)
candidates.label: probable

candidates.device: EVOS Gen 3 v2 LED board in BOOTLOADER mode (application runs as 0051). Do not flash; see docs/evidence/first_connection_2026-11-12.md
candidates.label: strongly_supported
basis: observed 2026-11-12 on our unit: bus-reported description 'EVOS Gen 3 v2 LED Board Bootloader' behind the microscope hub
fl1_v1.6 PearlScope64.exe lighting controller references PID_0057 next to PID_0051; EvosGenIII_LEDBoard_Bootloader64.dll lists 0DAD:0057 and exposes StartApp
alternatives: LED board whose application firmware is missing or damaged (also enumerates as 0057)

candidates.device: AMG board ID listed by the CN bootloader DLL (bootloader-mode or sibling board)
candidates.label: probable
alternatives: unrelated AMG product ID (e.g. Countess/Manta boards named in the same DLL)

candidates.device: Point Grey Chameleon USB 2.0, Sony ICX445AL 1/3" 1296x964 CCD (FlyCapture2 / pgrusbcam driver)
candidates.label: strongly_supported
basis: fl1_v1.6 PearlScope64.exe hard-codes USB\VID_1E10&PID_2005&REV_0003 next to 'Sony ICX445AL (1/3" 1296x964 CCD) Camera'
fl1_v1.6 ships pgrusbcam.inf 2.3.3.59 and chameleon-v1.x .ez2 firmware
alternatives: a different Point Grey USB 2.0 model

candidates.label: probable
basis: usb.ids lists 1E10:2004 as 'Sony 1.3MP 1/3" ICX445 IIDC video camera [Chameleon]'
alternatives: camera in a different firmware mode

candidates.device: IDS uEye UI-146xLE-C colour camera (uEye API, uEye_usb_64.sys)
candidates.label: probable
basis: fl1_v1.6 PearlScope.ini names 'UI146xLE-C Color Camera' and AllowUEyeColorCamera
alternatives: any other IDS camera attached to the PC

non_usb_notes: Motion (X, Y, Z, epi/filter carriage F, objective turret O, phase turret P): Technosoft drives driven through TML_lib.dll/tmlcomm.dll over a COM port (\\.\COM%d scan; relay axis; CAN between axes). Expect a serial port (possibly USB-serial) in the microscope snapshot; its VID:PID is not referenced by the vendor software.
